newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH AUG WHOLESALES FALL, RETAIL SALES RISE - SF.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH AUG WHOLESALES FALL, RETAIL SALES RISE - SF.

text.p: The volume of Finnish wholesales fell 4.2 percent year-on-year in August and the value excluding value-added tax (VAT) of these sales fell 2.1 percent, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Wednesday.
The volume of retail sales rose 6.0 percent year-on-year in August and the value excluding VAT of these sales rose 6.7 percent, SF said.
"The August was dark for wholesalers. Sales volumes fell in all the sectors except in car wholesales," it said, noting that the growth in car wholesales was a modest two percent.

Development in different sectors of retail sales was mixed in August, but the total volume of retail sales rose clearly from August 1995 due to a 23.1 percent rise in the sales of motor vehicles, SF said.
In January-August, the volume of wholesales rose 1.7 percent and the value excluding VAT rose 2.7 percent, it said.
The volume of retail sales rose 3.7 percent year-on-year in January-August, and the value rose 4.3 percent, SF said.
